title: H.B. 2503 — Regulating artificial intelligence training data.
mechanism: Developers must post on their website documentation on the data used to train each generative AI system released on or after January 1, 2022, on or before January 1, 2027 and before each later public release or substantial modification. Exempt: systems whose sole purpose is security and integrity, aircraft operation, or national security or defense systems made available only to a federal entity. A violation is an unfair or deceptive act under the consumer protection act.
thresholds: No figure. Developer defined as a person, partnership, or corporation primarily engaged in developing or substantially modifying a generative artificial intelligence system intended for commercial distribution or public use.
penalties: A violation is an unfair or deceptive act in trade or commerce under the consumer protection act, chapter 19.86 RCW.
